breakpoints.name: two-area
breakpoints.purpose: Show both areas at or above this width; below it show the focused area.

palette.scope: Selection bar, active-field/input arrow, filter caret
Shared horizontal rules and vertical divider

layout.smallHeight: At height 1 render only the header; otherwise retain the final action and feedback rows when initial rows exceed height.
layout.fieldLabelWidth: min(max(9, maximum display width of field keys), max(1, workAreaWidth / 3))
layout.bounds: ANSI-aware display width, truncation and cell padding; every final row clips to the terminal width.

focus.hub: Tab toggles sessions/preview. Filtering shows sessions; help and kill confirmation show the work area.
focus.editor: Tab toggles sessions/form. Non-browse prompts and help show the work area. Resizing keeps the selected session and focused field visible.
focus.embeddedAdd: Tab toggles the editor rail/wizard unless help or discard confirmation owns input. Rail focus preserves the wizard and its buffers.
focus.standaloneAdd: Tab toggles configured sessions/wizard. Help or discard confirmation shows the work area.

colorPolicy.enabledProfile: ANSI256; Mox's own color styles use base palette indices
colorPolicy.noColorProfile: Ascii; strip all ANSI sequences from the completed workspace, including captured content and Bold/Underline
colorPolicy.noColorEnvironment: Non-empty NO_COLOR disables color and wins over CLICOLOR_FORCE=1.
colorPolicy.capturedContent: Preserve capture SGR attributes, expand tabs to 8-column stops, drop other control characters, truncate by display width, and reset after every capture row.

components.name: Workspace frame
traits: Shared header, titles, rules and fixed footer locations
Single divider, no enclosing panel boxes
Narrow view selects the focused area
Final clipping and no-color stripping

components.name: Session rail
traits: State shape and word
Bar and bold/underline identify selection
Filter line separated from rows
Continuation count and model-owned scroll offset

components.name: Text input
traits: Active prompt arrow
Visible input tail and block caret
Wide-character display width
Printable / and ? remain input in text states

components.name: Action row
traits: Bold foreground keys and plain foreground labels
Whole key/action pairs with middle-dot separators
Context-sensitive availability
Reserve room for help when available

components.name: Feedback row
traits: Stable final row
Pending operation, save/draft state, error or next action
Emphasis uses bold terminal foreground

components.name: Task work area
components.source: internal/cli/hub_ui.go: previewPane; editor_ui.go: rightLines / formLines; add_ui.go: detailLines
traits: Live capture or stopped-session summary
Focused-field help and validation
Review, confirmation and changed-file content replace the current task
Editor embeds add without a second frame

editorDiscardEdits.result: Open save/discard/stay guard; do not discard immediately

editorDelete.saved: Confirm, then buffer deletion; s writes and D undoes pending deletion
editorDelete.newDraft: Confirm before discarding the unsaved added session

editorSave.normal: Validate, show canonical diff, then Enter writes config
editorSave.guard: Choosing s in the guard confirms save directly; commit pending input and validate before continuing

embeddedAdd.completion: Keep as draft, or review/save/start through the editor; the embedded wizard does not write config itself
embeddedAdd.back: Keep input buffers and committed choices
embeddedAdd.source: internal/cli/editor_ui.go: updateWizard; internal/cli/add_ui.go: Update / back / detailLines

help.commandStates: Show contextual keyboard help; Esc or ? closes it
help.textStates: Insert literal ?; literal / also remains text

draftProtection.editor: Changing sessions with a dirty draft or leaving with dirty/pending input opens a save/discard/stay guard
draftProtection.add: Cancel with draft input opens a discard/keep-editing decision

evidence.authority: Implemented Go styles and model behavior; screenshots confirm the shared frame. Screenshot font and RGB palette are renderer settings, not application tokens.

formatLimits: Frontmatter spacing/dimensions use terminal cell/row strings. CSS color and font primitives are omitted.
Terminal component traits live here instead of fabricated HTML/CSS snippets or browser state previews.
Palette indices cannot provide fixed RGB swatches or synthesized tonal ramps for user-defined terminal themes.

narrative.overview:
Mox keeps a stable session rail beside the current task. The hub, editor, and
add flow share the same frame, so an operator can inspect a session, change its
configuration, and review a draft without rebuilding their sense of place.

The material is terminal text: native foreground, bold and underline, thin
rules, and small state marks. Density follows the available terminal cells.
The user's font, size, background, and palette remain native.
keyCharacteristics: One shared frame for navigation, work, actions, and feedback.
Keyboard focus and session state remain visible without color.
Add, review, and draft decisions occupy the current work area.
Terminal width controls composition while selection and input persist.

rules.name: The Terminal Inheritance Rule
rules.body: Keep essential text on the terminal foreground. Color supplements a mark or state word and never owns a decision.

rules.name: The Stable Frame Rule
rules.body: Change the work area's content for review, help, errors, and confirmations while preserving the frame and session context.

rules.name: The Explicit Draft Decision Rule
rules.body: Name the affected work and show the available save, discard, or stay action before abandoning it.

dos: **Do** reuse the shared frame for the hub, editor, and add flow.
**Do** pair state marks with words wherever row width permits.
**Do** keep selection, focused input, and draft state through resizing.
**Do** keep errors and the next useful action in the current work area and feedback row.
**Do** preserve literal printable input before applying command shortcuts.
donts: **Don't** assign fixed colors, fonts, or pixel dimensions to terminal-native roles.
**Don't** enclose the two workspace areas in individual panel boxes.
**Don't** dim essential text or depend on color to distinguish session ownership.
**Don't** split a displayed key/action pair to fit a narrow footer.
**Don't** discard dirty editor work directly from the discard-edits shortcut.
